method: Every one of 48 actual native models opened as paired original source/model sheets in all six views. Each inspection binds the actual GLB, native, source, six renders and comparison sheet bytes. All 48 natives separately reopened read-only; actual GLB physical tests independently recompute contacts, tool distances, shaft endpoints and opaque roof rays.
scope: All 48 basic humanoid heads/hoods/closed helmets seated directly on real upper clothing, preserving full head assemblies; Engineer six whole-head hammer air gaps and real grasp; Cleric six straight vertical rest staffs and five solid closed mitre roofs. Older angular appearance/equipment stays within existing geometric source style.
negativePhysicalRegressionsDetected: Actual head translated 150 mm above torso with original named pivot/metadata retained.
Actual hammer translated 300 mm into head area.
Actual Cleric shaft tilted by 0.1 rad.
Actual solid Cleric roof meshes removed while fitted open-mitre base remains.
explicitUserDesignOverrides: Compact head assembly directly on clothing replaces former exposed neck in all48.
Vertical Cleric carried staff replaces tilted source poses.
Engineer whole connected carrying arm moves outward for hammer/face clearance.
Previously requested Stormcaller normal short hair and lightning crown replace old source quiffs.
Previously requested Frostwarden I white collar remains; original rank I art lacked it.
limitations: Raster concepts do not supply physical dimensions; absolute scale, hidden depth and camera remain estimates.
No exact 1% landmark or 0.97 silhouette IoU certification.
Finite rest views and independent physical samples establish only these inspected interfaces; animated contact/effect audit is handled separately.
